question: By what principle are Sadashiva-onward counted separately?
premises: Sadashiva and the rest are counted separately — what principle
in the self supported by Brahma Vishnu Hara Ishana Susiva
inference: Separate counting rests on five-supported selfhood; the principle is questioned.
plain_english: Sadashiva and the rest are counted separately — what principle? In the self supported by Brahma Vishnu Hara Ishana Susiva.
